note: Six synthetic 32-bit hardware runs with default outlines, all layers and fresh artwork fades every two seconds. Hidden HWND submissions, not physical presentation or MusicBee scrolling. Native implementation matches final release. Artwork animation alone does not re-rasterize/upload retained foreground; existing palette animation still refreshes foreground colours.

metadata.mode: hardware HWND composition, unpaced; no display FPS claim
metadata.workload: all layers; fresh lyrics, palette motion; two dancers, identical poses/transforms; GPU composition when supported at 4K
metadata.cadence_note: Synthetic hidden-window submissions, not physical presentation or MusicBee responsiveness

runs.notes: Times are milliseconds except CPU percent, memory MiB, LyricOutlinePoints (cached path point count) and SkippedRenderDeadlines (counts, summed across frames). Scene/layers/FrameWork are nested; do not sum all metrics. PaintDispatch includes WinForms buffer copy, not display scan-out. FrameInterval is WM_PAINT cadence, not proven presentation. FrameWakeLateness is UI callback time minus requested deadline. CPU covers the entire host process. Missing metrics are unavailable, not zero cost.
